tool_args.rationale: The previous submission failed operationally because its fit tried to read y from a single prediction row; it provided no evidence against a stationary mechanism. The seven paid rows include a clear gradient response and a saturating input trend, consistent with the archived two-layer siphon plus open-branch formula. Fit its three parameters numerically and obtain a valid fresh confirmation before spending on another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The available rows span varied input and gradient, sufficient to fit and test the documented three-parameter static siphon branch; the 5-parameter memory ODE would require a separate trajectory dataset.
No high-frequency chaotic signature is reported, and the previous model attempt ended in a KeyError before producing any scientific confirmation or refutation.
These ignore the marked gradient effect demonstrated by the open-branch observations.
